title: Answer: societies, compound individuals, minds and consciousness emerge

statements.text: Enduring objects, societies, living persons and minds emerge as routes and societies of occasions. In compound individuals a higher-level occasion emerges with causal power of its own, as the mind emerges from the brain each moment. Consciousness emerges in high-grade occasions as a form of experience, though experience itself does not emerge.

sources.quote: In the latter, a higher-level of actuality has emerged, thereby giving the society as a whole a unity of experience and activity
The cumulative nature of the creative advance makes Whitehead an emergentist rather than constitutive panpsychist
